releases.body:
- Cap the in-memory summary cache at maxSummaryCacheEntries (default 10000) so memory stays bounded in long-running processes.
- Evict the oldest entry (Map preserves insertion order) when the cap is hit.
- Expose maxSummaryCacheEntries option, documented in readme.md.
**Full Changes**: https://github.com/k98kurz/opencode-fixtodo/compare/v0.0.2...v0.0.3
